rationale: The workflow already implements every applicable evidence-supported optimization. Dependency caching is present for Go modules (setup-go@v7 cache: true with cache-dependency-path: go.sum in backend and web jobs), pnpm (setup-node@v7 cache: pnpm with cache-dependency-path: web/ui/pnpm-lock.yaml in web and web-e2e jobs), and Playwright browsers (actions/cache@v6 on ~/.cache/ms-playwright in web-e2e), satisfying P-LIT-GHA-CACHE; the contraindication 'an equivalent cache already exists' applies, so adding another cache would be redundant. All three jobs already carry explicit timeouts (backend 15, web 15, web-e2e 20 minutes), satisfying P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT; without a measured timing baseline (repository CI history is marked not_a_measured_baseline) there is no representative history to justify retightening limits, and the contraindication that valid slow runs could exceed a new limit applies. Concurrency with cancel-in-progress: true already cancels superseded in-progress runs per workflow and ref, satisfying P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not apply because there is no matrix; P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE and P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE do not apply because there are no scheduled triggers; P-LIT-BAZEL-* do not apply because there is no Bazel build; P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT lacks the required successful-duration history; and test selection/skipping or environment-reuse patterns are out of workflow scope or would reduce required coverage. No supported, non-redundant change preserves the intended build and test coverage.
